reuse.why: Reuses recurConfigToRSchedule, RSchedule and getDateWithSkippedWeekend, but the daily-skip vs move-to-weekday decision is rewritten inline rather than shared with getUpcomingDates/getNextDate.

duplication.why: The skipDailyWeekends computation, weekend filter and conditional getDateWithSkippedWeekend mapping are copied almost verbatim from getUpcomingDates (a third copy alongside shared/schedules getNextDate).

placement.why: The handler sits next to getUpcomingDates in schedules/app.ts and is registered like its siblings, though the occurrence-adjustment rule arguably belongs in shared/schedules.ts.

scope.why: Only the new handler, its registration, an import and its tests are added.

maintainability.why: A change to weekend handling now has to be made in three places that each re-derive the same decision.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Calls the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend; no shared occurrence-adjustment abstraction exists to bypass.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied block from getUpcomingDates keeps the same names and structure; it is plain, not disguised, duplication.
